errors.text_span: секторът "по-малко от 10" е в сив цвят и представлява около 26.2%
errors.evidence: The machine description incorrectly states the grey sector (по-малко от 10) has a value of 26.2%, but the reference indicates this is the case for the yellow sector (никога).
The description does not accurately represent the totality of the percentages, especially for the orange and blue sectors which together make up 16.7% but are improperly summarized.
The description lacks mention of the actual values representing 'между 10 и 20' and '20 или повече', leading to ambiguity regarding their numerical representation.
